_about: Raise first in (everyone folded to you), 100bb. Approximate GTO. 'raise' is the open range; everything else folds. SB plays raise-or-fold. Sizes in big blinds. Keys are 6-max seats; at 7-9 handed the LJ uses the UTG chart and the seats before it use EP1 (one seat before the LJ) to EP3 (UTG at 9-handed).

EP3.raise: 55+, A3s+, KTs+, QTs+, JTs, T9s, 98s, AJo+, KQo

EP2.raise: 44+, A2s+, KTs+, QTs+, JTs, T9s, 98s, 87s, AJo+, KQo
